items.title: AI 写代码太快，人类测试跟不上了，Meta 用新方法把 bug 检出率提升 4 倍
items.raw_excerpt: Meta 报告称，通过一种 即时（Just-in-Time，JiT）测试方法 提升了软件质量。该方法在代码评审期间动态生成测试，而不是依赖长期存在、需要人工维护的测试套件。根据 Meta 的工程博客及相关研究，这一方法在 AI 辅助开发环境中将缺陷检测能力提升了约 4 倍。

title_i18n.zh: AI 写代码太快，人类测试跟不上了，Meta 用新方法把 bug 检出率提升 4 倍
title_i18n.en: AI writes code too fast for human testers to keep up, so Meta has increased bug detection rates fourfold with a new method.
title_i18n.es: La IA escribe código demasiado rápido, los humanos no pueden seguir el ritmo en las pruebas, y Meta ha aumentado la tasa de detección de errores en 4 veces con un nuevo método.

excerpt_i18n.zh: Meta 报告称，通过一种 即时（Just-in-Time，JiT）测试方法 提升了软件质量。该方法在代码评审期间动态生成测试，而不是依赖长期存在、需要人工维护的测试套件。根据 Meta 的工程博客及相关研究，这一方法在 AI 辅助开发环境中将缺陷检测能力提升了约 4 倍。
excerpt_i18n.en: Meta reports that software quality has been improved through a Just-in-Time (JiT) testing method. This approach dynamically generates tests during code reviews, rather than relying on long-standing test suites that require manual maintenance. According to Meta's engineering blog and related research, this method has increased defect detection capability by approximately four times in AI-assisted development environments.
excerpt_i18n.es: Meta informa que ha mejorado la calidad del software mediante un método de prueba Just-in-Time (JiT). Este enfoque genera pruebas dinámicamente durante la revisión de código, en lugar de depender de conjuntos de pruebas de larga duración que requieren mantenimiento manual. Según el blog de ingeniería de Meta y la investigación relacionada, este método ha aumentado la capacidad de detección de defectos aproximadamente 4 veces en entornos de desarrollo asistido por IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: On April 17, 2026, the Zeekr 8X, the new-generation flagship SUV from Zeekr, officially entered mass production and market launch. The vehicle-integrated intelligent system Super Eva, equipped with advanced models including Step 3.5 Flash, completed the critical transition from technological unveiling to mass production, and is now being delivered to consumers. This also marks a milestone for Step 3.5 Flash, following its open-source release and top ranking in weekly usage on OpenRouter in March this year, as it moves from the open-source community to large-scale commercial deployment in end-user products. The Zeekr 8X, featuring Super Eva, is also China's first mass-produced vehicle to deliver a "Grok+FSD" experience. Over the past year, the domestic in-vehicle AI sector has seen significant buzz around integrating large models into vehicles, but the leap from lab demos to consumer-ready mass production has remained a major industry hurdle. The official launch of Super Eva signifies that the vehicle-integrated intelligent system, powered by Step's underlying models, now possesses the capability for large-scale deployment targeting real users and real driving scenarios. Super Eva was jointly developed by Step, Geely, and Qianli Technology. It is the first vehicle-integrated intelligent system to seamlessly integrate smart cockpit, intelligent assisted driving, and digital ecosystems, natively merging with underlying control systems such as autonomous driving, chassis, and powertrain. Its technical philosophy aligns closely with the conversational control architecture represented by Tesla's Grok, earning it the title of China's first "Grok+FSD" system, debuting in the Zeekr 8X.

items.title: From hours to minutes: How Agentic AI gave marketers time back for what matters
items.raw_excerpt: In this post, we share how AWS Marketing’s Technology, AI, and Analytics (TAA) team worked with Gradial to build an agentic AI solution on Amazon Bedrock for accelerating content publishing workflows.

title_i18n.en: From hours to minutes: How Agentic AI gave marketers time back for what matters
title_i18n.zh: 从数小时到几分钟：智能体AI如何为营销人员赢回宝贵时间
title_i18n.es: De horas a minutos: cómo la IA agéntica devolvió a los profesionales del marketing tiempo para lo que importa

excerpt_i18n.en: In this post, we share how AWS Marketing’s Technology, AI, and Analytics (TAA) team worked with Gradial to build an agentic AI solution on Amazon Bedrock for accelerating content publishing workflows.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文分享AWS营销技术、人工智能与分析团队如何与Gradial合作，在Amazon Bedrock上构建智能AI解决方案，以加速内容发布流程。
excerpt_i18n.es: En esta publicación, compartimos cómo el equipo de Tecnología, Inteligencia Artificial y Análisis (TAA) de Marketing de AWS colaboró con Gradial para construir una solución de IA agentica en Amazon Bedrock, con el fin de acelerar los flujos de trabajo de publicación de contenido.
